basic_details.job_title: VNSGU CRS Project Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Veer Narmad South Gujarat University has invited applications for the position of CRS Project Fellow (Junior) under a UGC-DAE-CSR sponsored research project in the Department of Chemistry under Dr. Sushma P. Ijardar, with a consolidated fellowship of Rs. 14,000/- per month plus HRA, for an initial tenure of one year extendable to three with satisfactory progress and UGC-DAE-CSR approval, requiring an M.Sc. (not earlier than 3 years) with a minimum of 55% marks in Chemistry, and candidates must apply by email to [email protected] on or before 5.00 P.M. on 20th November, 2026.

qualification.details: M.Sc. (not earlier than 3 years) with a minimum of 55% marks in Chemistry.

how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form available below the advertisement on the university website.
Fill out the application form with your details.
Compile the completed application form along with necessary documents in single PDF to [email protected].
Send the email on or before the last date i.e. 5.00 P.M. on 20th November, 2026.
Mention the “Application of project fellow” in the subject line of the email.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will not be considered. List of shortlisted candidates for further selection process will be notified through email only. Therefore, please mention active Mobile Number and Email ID in the application form. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed by email about the interview. The interview will be conducted at Department of Chemistry, VNSGU, Surat, Gujarat. Original documents, including age proof, certificates, degrees, mark sheets, and other testimonials, must be presented at the time of the interview. The student appointed under this project should spend a substantial amount of time at UGC-DAE CSR. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. Selected candidates will have to join duty immediately on receipt of the offer. All terms & conditions for this position will adhere to guidelines of UGC DAE CSR and VNSGU. The competent authority reserves the right to fill or not fill the position. Candidates selected for this position can also apply for PhD program of VNSGU, provided they satisfy the eligibility criteria.
